name: CreateDeployProgressDialog
title: Blocks/Create/CreateDeployProgressDialog
summary: The modal progress of one deploy that sends several Deployment Settings live, each on its own, and the drop-to-deploy confirm that starts it. The `Dialog` is titled Deploying… 2 of 5 done while it runs, can be hidden at any time (Hide while running, Close once settled; the toast keeps reporting and Show progress reopens it); under the title the tally says how many succeeded and failed and that the ones that succeeded stay live. A `Progress` bar and Deploying <name> track the run, a `ToggleGroup` filters All, Remaining, Failed and Done with their counts, and each row names the settings and the environments and projects it reaches, with a `Spinner` and a status `Tag` while it deploys and an `OutcomeIcon` once it settles. When the run settles the header gains a large `OutcomeIcon` and the outcome reports through one toast with Edit and Redeploy, as every async action does, raised only while the dialog is hidden so it never covers the dialog's footer; a failed row says why and the footer offers Retry failed. The toast stays the standard for deploys: this dialog is only for the drop-to-deploy and multi-settings path. Built from `Dialog`, `PanelHeader`, `PanelBody`, `PanelFooter`, `Progress`, `ToggleGroup`, `Spinner`, `Tag`, `OutcomeIcon`, `Button`; its toasts go through `toast` into the app's one toast region (ToastPlugin, or one Toaster at the app root), never a Toaster in the page body. The page behind it is a page body for ConsoleLayout.

variants.name: Drop
variants.summary: The drop-to-deploy confirm: New production deployment, the service with a Production `Tag`, what the files replace, and the dropped folder with its file count, total size and a scrollable list of up to 100 paths (an 'and N more' line counts the rest) with sizes formatted by `Intl.NumberFormat`. Cancel closes; Deploy to Production opens the progress dialog and starts the run.

variants.name: PartialError
variants.summary: Settled with one failure: Deployed 4 of 5 Deployment Settings with a warning `OutcomeIcon`, staging-settings marked Failed with the reason, Retry failed beside Close, and no toast while the dialog shows the outcome; a run that settles while the dialog is hidden raises an error toast with Edit (reopens the dialog on the failed rows) and Redeploy.

variants.name: Success
variants.summary: Every Deployment Setting deployed: a large animated success `OutcomeIcon` beside Deployed 5 Deployment Settings, every row Done, Close enabled, and no toast while the dialog shows the outcome; a run that settles while the dialog is hidden raises a success toast with Edit and Redeploy.
